As mentioned in my first post, here i am sharing my another interview experience .
 
🌟 Interview Experience at Truecaller (November 2024) 🌟
📝 Round 1: Assignment Round 📝
In the first round, I was given an assignment that included a design question. My task was to create a comprehensive design document for an end-to-end data pipeline. Additionally, there was a hands-on component involving Spark and Airflow. I completed the assignment within 3-4 days, and I was subsequently shortlisted for the next round.
💻 Round 2: Technical Interview 💻
The second round was a one-hour session conducted by 2-3 engineers. They asked numerous questions focusing on Spark optimization and my previous projects. The primary focus areas for this round were Spark and Kafka.
👔 Round 3: Hiring Manager Interview 👔
This round was with the hiring manager and was centered on my projects and work experience. It included some behavioral questions to assess my fit for the role and the company.
🤝 Round 4: Behavioral Interview 🤝
The final round was entirely behavioral, concentrating on the values I could bring to the company. It involved many scenario-based questions to evaluate my problem-solving skills and cultural fit.
🎉 Outcome 🎉
After successfully clearing all the rounds, I received an offer letter within 3-4 days.
💡 Advice 💡
Focus on strengthening your knowledge and skills in Spark, SQL, and Kafka, as these areas are crucial for the interview process.
